reason: This is a broad semantic change to a core correctness-sensitive feature: enabling prepared-plan cache for partitioned tables. It touches `pkg/planner/core/plan_cache*`, partition processing/pruning, point-get/batch-point-get planning and execution, table partition metadata, and server/session prepared-statement paths, with substantial integration test churn. Cacheability mistakes here can yield wrong-plan reuse, stale partition selection, or incorrect point access/results, so the blast radius is high enough for a focused Blocker/High hunt.
